title: Carroll fermions, expansions and the lightcone
summary: We investigate fermions on Carrollian manifolds. We complement previous intrinsic analysis by deriving Carrollian fermion actions from a relativistic Dirac theory via a systematic expansion in the speed of light ($c$). We then study relativistic fermions in light-cone coordinates and their connection to Carrollian fermions in one lower dimension. This follows from the recent observation that the Poincaré algebra, written in lightcone coordinates contains (two) co-dimension one Carroll sub-algebras.
